title: A failed ensemble-field update never strands an open transaction
statement: StorageBackend.update_trade_ensemble_fields writes under _write_ctx, so an UPDATE that raises is rolled back before the write lock is released and the shared connection keeps accepting writes.
failure_mode: update_trade_ensemble_fields took the bare lock instead of _write_ctx, so an UPDATE aborted after its implicit BEGIN left the shared connection inside a transaction: the BUGFIX-001 deadlock that blocks every later write and the WAL checkpoint on close. _write_ctx was introduced for exactly this and this write site was missed; the deciding test aborts the UPDATE and checks the connection is out of the transaction.
